## Listing

- [ ] `apps/<id>/app.json` follows the schema; `scripts/check-app.sh` passes.
- [ ] Icon 256 × 256 grayscale; screenshots 632 × 840 grayscale, no device frames, no text over pictures.
- [ ] The description says plainly what the app does; `changes` flags are true and complete.
- [ ] The licence is named and allows what `source` says (`hosted` needs a redistributable licence or a first-party PrimitiveOS app).

## Quality bar

- [ ] A real touch interface; simple for someone who has never jailbroken a device.
- [ ] A kind of app that is popular on iOS or Android (productivity, games, everyday tools).
- [ ] Works with Primitive Launcher in front; does not run inside the Kindle's own interface.

## Testing

- [ ] Tested on: <Kindle model and firmware>
- [ ] Install, open, return to the launcher, remove: done on the Kindle.
